claims.evidence: Photos show a mountain bike with suspension and disc brakes but cannot prove strength or durability.
Working condition of gears, brakes, and chain is not shown in the photo.

risks.risk: Brand and model are unknown, which sets the base value.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the frame branding and model name.
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unbranded or unknown-model mountain bike

risks.risk: Age or year of manufacture is unknown.
risks.proof: Photo of the serial number or a dated receipt.
risks.if_unproven: priced as an older bike of unspecified age

risks.risk: Gears, brakes, and chain may not work.
risks.proof: Video clip of the bike being ridden through all gears and braking.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or needing full service

risks.risk: Frame may have cracks, dents, or poor repairs.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all frame tubes, welds, and joints.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having an unknown or damaged frame

risks.risk: Tire tread may be worn out.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the tire tread on both wheels.

proof_requests: Clear photo of frame brand and model name
Video of gears shifting and brakes working
Close-up photos of frame condition and tire tread
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a mountain bike with visible features, so a worst-case price can be set despite unknown condition and specs.
